Title: Car collides with scooter downtown
Article Text: A car struck a scooter near downtown. The driver was reportedly speeding through a red light and did not stop.

Title: Minor parking lot fender bender
Article Text: Two cars collided at low speed in a parking lot. No injuries reported.

Title: Pedestrian struck crossing Main St
Article Text: A pedestrian was hit by a delivery van while crossing Main Street during rush hour. Witnesses say the van ran a stop sign.

Title: Cyclist swerves to avoid pothole
Article Text: A cyclist lost control after swerving to avoid a large pothole and fell onto the sidewalk. Minor scrapes reported.

Title: Highway multi-car pileup
Article Text: Six vehicles were involved in a chain-reaction collision on the highway during heavy fog. Several injuries reported.

Title: Scooter rider grazes parked car
Article Text: An electric scooter rider clipped a parked car while trying to merge into a bike lane. Minor cosmetic damage.

Title: Truck rear-ends sedan at light
Article Text: A delivery truck failed to stop in time and rear-ended a sedan waiting at a red light.

Title: Motorcycle loses control on curve
Article Text: A motorcyclist lost control on a sharp curve in wet conditions and slid into a guardrail.
